description: Numbered hierarchical structure for SaaS startups covering product development, customer success, go-to-market strategy, and operations.

structure.name: 10-19-product
structure.description: Product development, engineering, and technical documentation

children.name: 11-engineering
children.description: Source code repositories, technical specs, architecture docs

children.name: 12-product-management
children.description: Product roadmaps, feature specs, user stories, PRDs

children.name: 13-design
children.description: UI/UX designs, wireframes, design systems, user research

children.name: 14-qa-testing
children.description: Test plans, bug reports, QA documentation

children.name: 15-devops
children.description: Deployment configs, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure docs

structure.name: 20-29-customers
structure.description: Customer success, support, and relationship management

children.name: 21-customer-success
children.description: Onboarding materials, success playbooks, health scores

children.name: 22-support
children.description: Support tickets, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides

children.name: 23-customer-feedback
children.description: Feature requests, surveys, user interviews, NPS data

children.name: 24-customer-data
children.description: Usage analytics, customer profiles, retention metrics

structure.name: 30-39-sales-marketing
structure.description: Go-to-market strategy, sales operations, and marketing campaigns

children.name: 31-sales
children.description: Sales decks, proposals, pipeline data, CRM exports

children.name: 32-marketing
children.description: Campaign assets, content calendar, marketing analytics

children.name: 33-website
children.description: Website content, landing pages, blog posts, SEO

children.name: 34-partnerships
children.description: Partner agreements, co-marketing materials, integration docs

children.name: 35-brand
children.description: Logo files, brand guidelines, marketing templates

structure.name: 40-49-operations
structure.description: Business operations, finance, legal, and HR

children.name: 41-finance
children.description: Financial statements, invoices, budgets, expenses

children.name: 42-legal
children.description: Contracts, NDAs, terms of service, privacy policies

children.name: 43-hr-people
children.description: Employee records, hiring, onboarding, policies

children.name: 44-investors
children.description: Pitch decks, cap tables, investor updates, board materials

children.name: 45-metrics-reporting
children.description: SaaS metrics, dashboards, monthly reports, OKRs

structure.name: 50-59-integrations
structure.description: Third-party integrations, APIs, and partner technical docs

children.name: 51-api-docs
children.description: API documentation, webhooks, developer guides

children.name: 52-integration-partners
children.description: Partner API keys, integration specs, technical requirements

structure.name: 60-69-security-compliance
structure.description: Security protocols, compliance documentation, and audits

children.name: 61-security
children.description: Security policies, incident reports, penetration tests

children.name: 62-compliance
children.description: SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA documentation, audit reports
